name: Vehicle Computer ROS 2 Jazzy
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'bashrc_path="${HOME}/.bashrc"; touch "$bashrc_path"; grep -qxF "source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash" "$bashrc_path" || printf "%s\n" "source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash" >> "$bashrc_path"; grep -qxF "[ -f /workspace/install/setup.bash ] && source /workspace/install/setup.bash" "$bashrc_path" || printf "%s\n" "[ -f /workspace/install/setup.bash ] && source /workspace/install/setup.bash" >> "$bashrc_path"; pre-commit install --install-hooks && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && vcs import src --skip-existing < dependencies.repos && rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src --rosdistro jazzy -y --skip-keys="libcamera vehicle_computer_runtime"'
